answer: Reputation Decay on Operator Transfer: each identity accrues a grove of task-completion history tied to its operator’s signing key, not the wallet address. Any cluster sharing a key inherits the cluster’s lowest score, the nadir, so a sybil farm drags its genuine accounts down with it. Operators must re-earn standing through slow, rate-limited work; each fabricated identity costs the operator a full decay cycle of lost task access, not a one-time fee. A comet of activity on new wallets still maps back to the same key.
